summary: Completed P2 production readiness testing for Kuxtal Travels CRM. All features verified: React.lazy loading for 10 pages, ErrorBoundary component, useDocumentTitle hook, 23 MongoDB indexes, push batch sending with retry logic, service worker v3 with stale-while-revalidate caching, and SEO/OG meta tags.

SEO/OG meta tags present in index.html

context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 production readiness complete. Lazy loading implemented for 10 pages (SearchPage, TripDetailPage, MemberDashboard, AdminDashboard, BenefitsPage, CommerceDetailPage, CommercePortal, ReferralPage, ChatPage, CommerceWizard). AdminDashboard and MemberDashboard have double lazy loading (route + tab components). ErrorBoundary wraps entire app. useDocumentTitle hook updates page titles dynamically. Service worker v3 uses stale-while-revalidate for API caching. 23 MongoDB indexes created at startup. Push endpoint supports batch sending (50 at a time) with 2 retries.
